searchText: Are more people having problems downloading these tars from GH? Also happened last week for me, switching to `wget` fixes Cool, and BAL entries are back in the blockchain tests 😄 Great work! sounds like bandwidth limiting on gh side tbh. Hi, would it be possible to add the serialized BAL RLP to the test data from blockchain tests? That would be helpful to debug serialization issues! 🙏 We could add this to blockchain test, but you can reference the `blockchain_engine` version of the same test as it is part of the engine requests. Does this help? I was running v4.0.0 state tests and they fail a lot on transfer logs and selfdestruct logic 🧵 Ahhhh nice! Yes I see now blockchain test has JSON format and engine has the access list as RLP. Question regarding the engine API design, why is this part of the ExecutionPayload and not part of the extra params of request like e.g. `executionRequests`? I'm confused here why BAL is part of ExecutionPayload and why executionRequests it /not/ part of ExecutionPayload In v5.0.0 tests, transfer to itself produces the transfer log. This looks like a waste as no balance was transferred. Imo EIP needs clarification in this case, and would clarify it by adding if `address == target` do not create the transfer log. I think it was decided to just emit a log rather than create a special edge case. but I agree that the spec should not emit a log in this case. we still have time to change it. This would match the case for `CALL`: > Any nonzero-value-transferring CALL to a different account, at the time that the value transfer executes The tx one now has an edge case and is treated different than CALL, as tx thus emits a log also if target is self. I find the `SELFDESTRUCT` section slightly ambiguous, dus this only mean selfdestruct in the sense of https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6780 (so not in case of `SENDALL` ?) Yeah this does not feel so clear. Related conversation [here](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/688075293562503241/1465722727481475174) likewise, related conversation here https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/688075293562503241/1465804585187803283

The tx one now has an edge case and is treated different than CALL, as tx thus emits a log also if target is self.
